text_block_list.text:
Since Mr. C.B. wasn't feeling well, I 
decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so fluffy. Well then, I'll go ahead 
and take a rest right away.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Where is this? Is this... a dream?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Either way... It feels 
like I can run my best!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, hello there.

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text:
Having reached this realm, you are the 
chosen one— Come, state your desire. 
Anything—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. Could you tell me later? I'm 
going for a quick run.

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hold up!? Wait a sec! Make your wish, 
dammit!

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text: —Maaaaake a wiiiiish...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew, this feels so good...! I wonder how 
far this view goes on.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I haven't run nearly enough yet...! Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... To think that even I can't 
catch up in this realm...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! It feels like my feet are 
floating! It's incredible! I can go 
anywhere, totally free—

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text:
I-It's frustrating, but... divine...! 
She's even more... beautiful than me...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Ah. Just a dream, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That was such a pleasant dream, heheh. 
Huh, my body feels so much better too.

Perhaps thanks to having a good dream, Mr. 
C.B. seemed completely back in top shape!

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text: Take thaaaaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What is this? I can't move...?

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant*, caught you...! Now, hold 
still and let your wish be granted...!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. Could you please stop that? 
What exactly are you trying to do?"

text_block_list.name: Divine Woman
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you I'll grant your damn wish 
already!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Then grant it. Set me free.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Was it a dream?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I just can't shake this feeling. I 
really wanted to run there...

It seemed she had had a bad dream, and Mr. 
C.B.'s slump persisted...
